info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API enables users to access and list various partners involved in hotel loyalty programs. This API serves as a valuable resource for travel agencies, hospitality platforms, and loyalty program managers seeking to enhance customer engagement through partnerships. By retrieving information on points-earning opportunities with different hotel partners, developers can create tailored experiences for users. This endpoint supports efficient integration of loyalty program data into applications, enabling businesses to maximize their customer loyalty strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partner points.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of partner points associated with the specified criteria. You can use this data to understand the available partnerships and their details.
